method: Editorial intent mapping from the actual guide content and bounded current web searches. These are target queries, not measured search volume, rankings or Search Console results.

guides.intent: Explain why quotes differ and which geometry or scope changes affect cost.
guides.boundary: Costs and quotation work, rather than a fixed price list or a machining service landing page.

secondary: what to include in a CNC quote request
guides.intent: Prepare the files, local requirements and commercial brief for a detailed quote.
guides.boundary: Initial inquiry and drawing inputs; detailed tolerance instruction belongs in the drawing guide.

secondary: CNC quote setup and finishing charges
guides.intent: Compare the same revision and scope, including missing work and first-order charges.
guides.boundary: Comparison of offers, rather than estimation of machining price.

guides.intent: Record which dimensions, fit, finish and functional checks approve the evaluated sample.
guides.boundary: Sample evidence and release decision; repeat-batch planning has its own guide.

guides.primary: CNC prototype to small batch production
guides.intent: Carry the accepted design and inspection conditions into a separately released batch.
guides.boundary: Repeat-production continuity, rather than retelling the prototype inspection checklist.

secondary: CNC quote DAP DDP delivery terms
guides.intent: Agree surface protection, labels, documents and the quoted delivery responsibilities.
guides.boundary: Shipment preparation under the actual order; no universal customs, tax or delivery promise.

guides.intent: Turn functional requirements into checkable drawing callouts and records.
guides.boundary: General drawing language; circular patterns, shafts and fittings receive product-specific guides.

guides.intent: Compare grade, temper and application requirements without confusing strength with stiffness.
guides.boundary: Material selection, rather than enclosure wall geometry or an inventory claim.

guides.primary: CNC milling vs turning vs 5 axis
guides.intent: Choose a route from the model, tool approach, support and controlled relationships.
guides.boundary: General route comparison; blade-specific access belongs in the impeller guide.

guides.primary: CNC material and surface finish specification
guides.intent: Connect grade, treatment, final dimensions and required acceptance records.
guides.boundary: General material and finishing scope; detailed anodizing boundaries have their own guide.

guides.intent: Review the wall, cavity, corner and lid interfaces of a specific enclosure design.
guides.boundary: Product geometry and tool access; alloy selection and general process comparison remain separate.

guides.intent: Connect bore, mounting face and clocking references to hole-pattern acceptance.
guides.boundary: Circular component relationships, rather than a complete GD&T standard tutorial.

guides.intent: Distinguish size, shoulder location and runout and select the relevant support and final condition.
guides.boundary: Turned mating interfaces; no universal bearing fit or runout limit.

guides.primary: machined fitting thread and seal requirements
guides.intent: Specify each end connection, seal interface, internal edge and separate functional test.
guides.boundary: A fitting drawing and acceptance scope, rather than a pressure-rating chart.

guides.intent: Check whether the located blank can produce the controlled finished bores, walls and flanges.
guides.boundary: Casting-to-machining preparation; no allowance copied between different casting processes.

secondary: plastic part inspection support and conditioning
guides.intent: Explain why grade, temperature, contact and support change dimensional comparison.
guides.boundary: Measurement conditions and mating clearance; material-specific data still govern numeric values.

secondary: impeller CAD model blade root access
guides.intent: Prepare controlled surfaces and review the complete tool path and inspection access.
guides.boundary: Impeller manufacturing geometry; balance, flow and operating performance require separate definitions.

guides.intent: Define the treated and protected regions and how the final fit will be accepted.
guides.boundary: Feature-level anodizing decisions, rather than duplicating the general finish guide.

secondary: intake manifold flange and seal interfaces
guides.intent: Connect internal passages, mating hardware, split joints and supplied assembly scope.
guides.boundary: Machined component and interface definition; no engine fitment or power claim from the reference image.

secondary: indexing plunger spring force and engagement
guides.intent: Specify installed reach, clearance, movement and functional checks alongside component dimensions.
guides.boundary: Pin and mechanism requirements; spring force is not the installed load capacity.
